summary: Iter 9 SEO cleanup verification — all 4 tasks + P0 prerender best-effort behaviour tested via starlette TestClient (bypasses preview k8s ingress + Cloudflare Host-spoof block). 22/22 tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 746 lines — approaching the split-threshold; consider modularising SEO + prerender routes into their own router file.

Motor AsyncIOMotorClient is bound to first event loop it touches, so starlette TestClient instances after the first raise 'Event loop is closed'. Tests must share a single module-scoped TestClient (documented in test_seo_iter9.py).

canonical_host_redirect middleware defaults scheme to request.url.scheme when x-forwarded-proto is absent — behind Cloudflare that will always be set, but if a direct HTTP request ever reaches uvicorn it would redirect to http://apex. Acceptable trade-off, worth documenting.
prerender-seo.mjs correctly bails to exit 0 in default mode and exits non-zero under SEO_PRERENDER_STRICT=1 — verified both paths.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 9 focus areas: (1) www.fidelislogic.com -> fidelislogic.com 301 middleware in server.py (~line 710), (2) root /sitemap.xml alias route (~line 730), (3) single meta description in frontend/public/index.html line 36, (4) prerender-seo.mjs bail()/STRICT semantics. All verified via /app/backend/tests/test_seo_iter9.py using a MODULE-SCOPED TestClient — DO NOT create per-test TestClient instances (Motor event-loop binding will break subsequent tests with 'Event loop is closed'). Preview URL /sitemap.xml at root gets routed to frontend dev server by k8s ingress so test via ASGI TestClient, not requests. build/sitemap.xml already present with 35 URLs from a previous yarn prerender run.
